title: OSD vocabulary of roles, state 1
description: A numbered state of the vocabulary of roles: the terms (parts and settings) a control's role is written with. A published state never changes; the next state is a new folder that only adds. What a schema cannot say (a name or a maker's word present twice, a term that composes a part and a setting already held, an `applies_to` or a `replaced_by` that names no term) the reader `osd` refuses at the pointer of the fault.

^_.description: A note for people; never read by a program.

state.description: The number of the state, written as a string.

^_.description: A note for people; never read by a program.

type.description: A part of the instrument, or what is set on a part.

definition.description: The term's definition, in one sentence.

applies_to.description: The parts, terms of type part of the same state, a setting applies to.

stands_under.description: The parts, terms of type part of the same state, a part may stand under in a path of a role.

at_top.description: Whether a part may open a path of a role. True when stands_under is absent, false when it is present, unless the part writes it.

words.description: The makers' words that mean this term, each with its origin.

source.description: Where the term comes from: the controllers of the MIDI 1.0 table of defined controllers whose composition uses it, and the rows of a published document (M2-104-UM table 22, M2-117-UM table 5) that name it.

shared_by.description: Devices of two makers at least that share the term, by name. The reader refuses a list whose devices are all of one maker.

replaced_by.description: The term of the same state that replaces this one, which keeps its place.

^_.description: A note for people; never read by a program.

document.description: The published document and its version: M2-104-UM v1.1.2.

number.description: The number of the row, when the table numbers its rows.

name.description: The name of the row in the table.
